identity.name: Son Doong Cave
identity.narrow: Son Doong Cave — один из наиболее выразительных природных объектов региона; подходит для ландшафта, wildlife/outdoor-сюжета и маршрутного видео.

languages_spoken: Bru-Van Kieu/Chut in parts of the region

currency.name: Vietnamese dong
currency.practical_notes: VND — основная валюта; наличные по-прежнему важны на рынках, в сельских районах и у небольших операторов.

story.narrative: Son Doong Cave — один из наиболее выразительных природных объектов региона; подходит для ландшафта, wildlife/outdoor-сюжета и маршрутного видео.

logistics.access: Expedition from Phong Nha through jungle/cave systems with licensed expedition operator; not accessible independently.
logistics.public_transport: Operator-managed expedition logistics from Phong Nha; no public transport to cave entrance.
logistics.last_mile: Multi-day trekking, river crossings, technical cave travel and camps.
logistics.permit_or_guide: Mandatory expedition booking, trained guides/porters and conservation-controlled itinerary.
logistics.mobility_notes: Проверить ступени, грунт, лодочные посадки и доступность на официальной странице; природные и археологические объекты часто не безбарьерны.

climate.best_period: Operator season January through end of August; Apr–May often warm/green with cave mist/cloud effects.
climate.heat_rain_notes: Tour does not operate Sep–Dec due weather/safety conditions; underground temperature and river conditions differ from surface.
climate.site_specific_notes: Technical multi-day cave expedition; weather directly controls safe operation.

operations.hours: No day-ticket hours. Expedition only; 2026 operator information states the tour runs January through the end of August because of weather/safety.
operations.ticket: High-cost expedition package with strict capacity and booking; current price/availability must be taken from the licensed operator for the specific season.
operations.closure_notes: September–December non-operating period; additional weather/flood or conservation closures possible.

safety.crime_context: Специфической официальной crime-rate именно для объекта обычно нет. Страновой контекст: низкий–умеренный. Тяжёлая уличная преступность против туристов сравнительно редка; распространены phone/bag snatching, pickpocketing, tourist scams and traffic risk.
main_risks: ограниченная быстрая медицинская помощь в удалённых зонах
обычная осторожность с ценностями и транспортом
safety.confidence: site-specific crime statistics generally unavailable; operational risks are more actionable

visual_recon.best_time: dolines/sunbeams vary by season and time; follow expedition guide timing
visual_recon.drone: No assumption of drone permission; cave/national-park/expedition rules prevail.
visual_recon.filming_restrictions: Commercial filming requires separate operator/park permission; expedition movement and safety take priority over shooting.
